vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Hi, friends! Look at all the pretty flowers in my garden!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: And here come the butterflies! Let's count them together!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Count with your fingers, like Mila!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Bless you, Bobo! The butterflies are still here!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Oh! One butterfly landed on Bobo's nose!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Nine! Uh oh... I need more paws!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Ten butterflies! And ten fingers! Show me your ten fingers!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Now it's your turn to count them all! Ready? Point and count!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Wow fact! Butterflies taste with their feet!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: With their feet? Yuck! I mean... wow!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: A butterfly has legs, too! How many? Let's count!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: One, two, three, four, five, six!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Game time! Which flower has more butterflies?

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: This one! Five is more than three!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Now, which flower has less butterflies?

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: This one! Two is less than four!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Two butterflies are on the flower. One more flies in. How many now?

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Three! Two and one make three!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Three butterflies. Two more fly in. How many now?

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Five! Three and two make five!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Five butterflies. Oh! Two fly away. How many are left?

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Three! Five take away two is three!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Color quiz! What color is butterfly number one?

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: And what color is butterfly number five?

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: And where is the number four?

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: The sun is going down. The butterflies fly home to sleep. Let's count down!
